registration.notes: Front-door composition, seam 6 (FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-10 as ruled: START_IS_A_RELAY, SIXTH_ROUTE_START_SHADOW_RUN, NO_DEFINITION_CROSSES, ONE_STEP_AMENDMENT, TWO_LABELLED_PATHS): build_studio_context receives review_service_base_url (CR-2; since this seam also the Simulate screen's worker shadow-run relay over the worker's sixth route POST /review/runs), activation_root (seam 1), policy_registry and policy_identities (seam 2), provider_registry while UGENCE_STUDIO_SIMULATION_PROVIDER=1 (seam 3) and system_registry while UGENCE_STUDIO_SYSTEM_REGISTRY_PATH is set (seam 5); the frozen v2 contract is amended a second time (v2-A2) by the one operation v2_review_start_shadow_run; no configuration value, image package, credential or second egress destination is added; decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. Supersedes the seam-5 registration, which is never edited; a later seam registers a new record superseding this one.
